summary: Plan MICE events across tourism venues and suppliers. Practise budgets, risk controls and KPI reporting. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Corporate event management in tourism connects corporate MICE briefs with destination, venue and guest-service operations. This training is for event coordinators, tourism venue teams and destination-service professionals who turn briefs into workable delivery plans. It covers destination feasibility and event costing, supplier and guest-flow coordination, and practical risk, sustainability and KPI reporting, with introductory coverage of ISO 20121:2024 and ISO 31000:2018.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate business events with tourism destinations, venues, accommodation providers and visitor services. It is especially relevant if your work connects corporate event requirements with the operating realities of tourism suppliers.
modules: BEO, Run of Show and Guest Flow
prerequisites: This intermediate course suits you if you have experience supporting or coordinating events, tourism services or venue operations. No programming is required. Practical exercises use Excel; bring a laptop with existing Excel access. The course uses supplied case figures and workbook templates, so no specialist event software installation or personal account is required.
